messages: The first page of the #b#t2430047##k is still legible.\nLet's see what is written on the first page.
The first page of the #b#t2430047##k reads:\n#e#b"Where the sea meets a shore guarded by little snouts."#k#n\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.#k
Wedged in a crack in the rocks at #b#m10000021##k was the next sheet of the log.\nThe #b#t2430048##k is mine. Whoever left this trail meant it to be followed.
name: [Event] The First Mark
demandSummary: Find the secluded shore hidden somewhere on Victoria Island.
